headline: MVP paper reports lower modeled vision latency and energy through motion-domain speculation
summary: A September 2026 paper proposes a continuous-vision pipeline that predicts motion vectors, extrapolates perception between full inference frames, and runs drift correction asynchronously. On object-detection workloads, the authors report up to 66.8% lower P99 tail latency and 46% lower energy per produced output, with a small accuracy cost. The evaluation combines KITTI video, YOLOv8, a simulated real-time vision pipeline, gem5/DRAM/NPU models and a cycle-accurate RTL-validated ISP micro-pipeline; it is not a physical mobile-SoC deployment. The results are author-reported and were not independently reproduced.
